title: City Council District 7

statement.speaker: Warren Ashford
statement.topic: KONO Economic Sentiment & Small Business Retention
statement.quote: When stable storefronts become the exception rather than the expectation, that's when audits prove their worth.
statement.fullStatement: KONO's street trade holding steady while other corridors struggle points to deeper economic trends we need to understand. I'll be requesting the last six quarters' small-business retention reports from Economic Development to map service gaps. A 0.27 sentiment score against citywide 0.489 suggests something systemic - I want to see which interventions are working before we scale programs elsewhere.
statement.context: Continuing oversight of small business retention programs district-wide

action: Audit request for small-business retention reports in KONO
